The Quality Control Inspector, Level I/II, performs production inspections of hardware in accordance with established procedures, engineering drawings, specifications, and quality standards. jobs.title: Analyst, Quality Assurance
jobs.description_text:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

 

Your Impact on Our Mission

As a QA Analyst, you will play a key role in strengthening Zocdoc’s quality ecosystem by ensuring that every issue entering our engineering pipeline is accurate, validated, reproducible, and data-backed.

jobs.title: Senior Deal Desk Analyst ⭐
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused Senior Analyst, Deal Desk to help evolve and mature our Deal Desk function. This is a hands-on individual contributor role that combines day-to-day deal execution with subject matter expertise and functional ownership. You will operate as both a player and a builder—owning deal desk ticket execution and complex deal support while driving process optimization, automation, and scalable improvements. You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Finance to structure high-quality deals across land, expand, and renewal motions, directly impacting ARR growth, deal velocity, and long-term customer value. You will enable efficient deal progression while also building the frameworks, guardrails, and processes that create consistency and scale. You will balance strong collaboration and commercial flexibility with clear standards and operational rigor, ensuring deals support both immediate revenue objectives and sustainable growth, while reducing friction in the deal process by improving upfront clarity and enabling stronger deal structuring at the source.

jobs.title: Account Executive (Business Development)
jobs.description_text:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more. 

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

The Account Executive or Senior Account Executive is a high-impact sales role focused exclusively on acquiring net new advertisers to The Trade Desk platform. You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and closing new brand relationships, owning the full sales cycle from initial outreach through first scaled investment.

jobs.description_text: Our story began with a passionate idea that we could change the world.... And to be honest, we’ve never stopped believing that... In 1986 it was a simple concept that microbiology teamed with innovation and clinical contribution could eliminate an issue that was profoundly impacting the healthcare industry – HIV acquired through needle-stick injuries. In Australia, we lived out our dream. Investing years into R&D to create the safest containment system in the world and taking on the industry status quo to petition for higher standards in sharps protection, we witnessed an 80+ percent reduction in disposal-related needlestick injuries nationwide. And then we kept going... We are looking to bring on a Bilingual Accounts Receivable Specialist to our growing team in Canada. This can be a fully remote position and this person can live anywhere in Canada.

jobs.title: Kettle Crane Operator
jobs.description_text: Come join our team at Millennium Galvanizing! Millennium Galvanizing is a proud member of the American Galvanizing Association. We operate with a lead free kettle using special High Grade Zinc that is supported by the most technologically advanced equipment in our industry. Millennium Galvanizing can also perform painting, metalizing and paint over bare blasted steel as well as paint over galvanized steel for sensitive areas of installation that require an aesthetically pleasing coating application. The Kettle Crane Operator I operates the overhead bridge crane (Demag 5 ton / 10 ton) in a safe and effective manner to ensure high quality finished product is produced. This position operates the overhead bridge crane once the steel has been dipped in the zinc. The Kettle Crane Operator I will take the dipped steel and lower it in the water tank to complete the galvanizing process. They will then scrape and wipe any drips of excess zinc off the steel to ensure a neat finish.

jobs.title: Office Administrator
jobs.description_text: At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. We are looking to add a Senior Sales Support Technician to our team. In this position, you will support the preparation, setup, and execution of aerospace communications demonstrations, field tests, and customer engagement activities. Working closely with the Sales Consultant and engineering teams, this role assists in deploying and operating satellite communication systems, RF hardware, ground station equipment, and related technologies used to demonstrate product capabilities to prospective customers and partners. This position plays an important role in supporting technical demonstrations, validating system performance in real-world environments, and ensuring equipment and systems are properly configured for successful customer engagements. The Communications Technician will also support equipment maintenance, test preparation, and troubleshooting activities while helping translate technical system capabilities into successful customer demonstration experiences.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Programmatic

You will manage a portfolio of brand direct and agency clients across our US Central region, acting as their primary point of contact from campaign kickoff through quarterly business reviews. You will combine strong programmatic expertise with a performance-first mindset to deliver measurable results, uncover growth opportunities, and strengthen long-term partnerships. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about delivering impactful, client-centric solutions. The listed salary range reflects the base salary for this role and is dependent on experience and qualifications. In addition to base pay, this position is eligible for a variable incentive plan and a comprehensive benefits package.

You'll own day-to-day relationships and troubleshooting, but you'll also learn to think like a growth partner: understanding what makes each partner tick, spotting opportunities to expand the relationship, and helping partners get more value out of Equativ's Maestro platform over time. You don't need to be an expert in every part of programmatic advertising. We're looking for someone who has some exposure to digital advertising or AdTech, is curious and eager to learn, and genuinely enjoys building relationships and solving problems. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to build a foundation in programmatic advertising and curation, with room to grow into broader account ownership as our team and our partners' businesses scale. What You'll Do Own day-to-day relationships for a portfolio of partners, serving as a reliable point of contact for questions, requests, and troubleshooting. jobs.description_text: 👋 Hi! We are Equativ! Equativ is an AdTech leader created in 2001 on the belief that we can disrupt the on-line advertising industry. Headquartered in the heart of Paris and with offices in 19 countries, Equativ provides cutting-edge technologies that help hundreds of prestigious customers take back control and maximize their digital revenues with a flexible and transparent audience monetization platform. We can rely on a unique group of 700+ colleagues focused on excellence to shape our future. They continually embrace change and overcome challenges together to make innovation happen. That means we can offer you endless opportunities to do the same and let you shape the world you want! Equativ is looking for a proactive and strategic Sales Enablement Manager to join our Sales Enablement team. In this pivotal role, you will be the driving force behind our demand-side success across the APAC and MENA regions. You won't just be managing documents; you will be a key partner to our Sales teams, to plan, build, and continuously improve the collateral, tools and processes that help our sales teams win. By sitting at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Marketing, you will transform Equativ’s sophisticated tech capabilities into winning narratives that resonate with the world’s leading agencies and brands.

jobs.description_text: About the Role Equativ is looking for an SVP, National Sales to lead and grow our U.S. national sales an organization spanning New York, the Midwest, the West Coast, and Canada. We're looking for a sales leader who knows the programmatic advertising space, has deep relationships across major holding companies and independent agencies, and has a track record of growing revenue and winning new business. Just as important: someone who knows how to lead people. Externally, you're the face of Equativ's national sales effort, credible with senior agency and holding company decision-makers, comfortable in the room for the biggest pitches, and always looking for whitespace and new opportunity. Internally, you're building and running the team and setting the bar, creating consistency across three regions, coaching leaders and reps, and making the organization sharper and more accountable than it was before you got there. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to stay close to the market and close to the team, and who's ready to shape how national sales operates, competes, and wins. What You'll Do Lead the National Sales Organization Lead the North American national sales team across New York, the Midwest, the West Coast, and Canada setting clear priorities and creating alignment on where and how we grow. jobs.description_text: Purpose of the Job The AI Solution Architect is a senior individual-contributor member of the Solutions Architecture team, responsible for designing, documenting, and delivering solution-level architecture for initiatives that require AI, agentic, and machine learning capabilities. The role's focus is translating business and technical requirements into concrete, implementable solution designs — application architecture, integration patterns, data flows, and technology selection — for specific programs and projects, rather than setting enterprise-wide architecture strategy or standards. The incumbent carries a solution architecture caseload alongside their peers, designing AI/agentic solutions that integrate with existing systems across initiatives such as PC Financial (PCF) integration, the Enterprise Customer Information File (eCIF), and AML/Risk/Finance/Treasury delivery.
